title: cell
description: One planned episode: harness x model x task x kind x repeat. Built deterministically by abl_run from studies/<study>/design.yaml; the list's sha256 goes into the run manifest. Draft v0.

cell_id.description: readable id (task__kind__model__harness__rN); never shown to an observer

trace_id.description: opaque id: HMAC of cell_id under a per-run salt kept in the run's KEY/. The only id an observer sees (D-015)

harness.description: h1 = BreakingWeb LLMAgent text agent through the wrapper; bu = stock browser-use

inference.description: reasoning settings sent (D-3) and maxTokens (D-4); no temperature on any call

action_interface.description: agents act through Bedrock native tool calling for every model (D-013)
